title: Shooting stars are sand
caption: Most shooting stars are specks of space dust, many no bigger than a grain of sand.

beats.head: Most shooting stars are the size of a *grain of sand*.
They're not stars. They're *space dust* hitting our air.
They hit the air fast enough to *glow*.
beats.sub: Tens of kilometers per second, burning up high above you.

vis.note: how fast meteors hit the air

beats.head: Meteor showers happen when Earth crosses a *comet's* trail.
beats.sub: Same time every year, like a standing date.

beats.head: A speck of dust, and the whole sky *stops* for it.
Small things light people up *too*.
beats.sub: A good-morning text. Remembering their coffee order.

beats.head: Send this to someone you'd *wish* on a grain of sand for.
